title: Sheep bleating
author: earthcalling
changes: Trimmed to 5.50–7.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 120 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The high-pass is set to 120 Hz because the original field recording has wind rumble below 70 Hz.
